devices.deviceString: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1, Version 26.4 (Build 25E246))

protocol.readerValidation: tw-tools validated RUSAGE_INFO_V6 ABI, units, start identities and calibration. Fresh positive helper calibration before every window.
protocol.acceptance: Descriptive only. Exact input bytes/writes, parser/core work, logical settlement, per-target output and registered history; same-actor settled PNG; matching actual geometry; stable endpoint PID/type/start identities; native bracket encloses CDP CPU bracket; calibrated raw counters recompute.
protocol.replacementPolicy: Never repeat completed valid windows. Preserve failures; only rejected windows can receive a fresh identity.
protocol.coverage: Sequential non-atomic snapshots miss short-lived processes wholly between endpoints. Logical two-RAF endpoint is not a GPU fence. Kernel estimated CPU energy excludes GPU-device, display and other-process energy. Observer enabled and uncalibrated; no overhead subtraction.
protocol.cycleCaveat: At lower clock, memory stalls cost fewer cycles, slightly favouring the lower-clocked arm. A cycles win with an instructions loss needs stall analysis.

native.coverage: Stable endpoint PID/type/start identities. Short-lived processes entirely between endpoints are outside this coverage. Sequential CDP and per-PID counter reads are non-atomic.
